svg.title: Frozen errors across nominal and shifted cases
svg.desc: Field, maximum person-zone exposure-integral and threshold-duration errors for POD, POD-DEIM and a static nominal-trajectory lookup across five predeclared synthetic cases. Gate segments show nominal and single-shift limits; the combined case has no acceptance gate.
